name: IMAGE_PIPELINE
description: USB CDC transfers CRC-checked 800 x 480 monochrome images. RP2040 keeps a previous frame, updates the changed rectangle and periodically performs a clean full refresh.

name: HOST
description: Python epaper.py converts images and sends framed, CRC-checked commands.

name: USB
description: USB 2.0 Full Speed device; CC pull-downs, ESD protection and data series resistors.

name: MCU
description: Two 48,000-byte frames; bounds and CRC checks; changed-region calculation; BUSY timeout and power sequencing.

name: FLASH
description: Firmware storage and RP2040 ROM BOOTSEL programming.

name: SPI
description: GP10 SCK, GP11 MOSI, GP9 CS, GP8 DC, GP12 RESET and GP13 BUSY.

name: EPAPER_DISPLAY
description: 7.5-inch raw 800 x 480 monochrome panel. Partial updates follow a full baseline; clean full refresh after five partial updates.

name: POWER_TREE
description: USB 5 V feeds independent MCU and switched-panel regulators. All high-voltage panel boost and reservoir components are on the controller PCB; no external display driver board is needed.

name: RP2040
description: Internal 1.1 V core regulator; local bypass and core capacitors.

name: PANEL_REG
description: GP14 enables U4. R9 holds the panel supply off during reset.
